name: Market Recorder
description: Records BTC-USD and ETH-USD top of book and trades from Coinbase's public feed, around the clock on trade1.
skill: A service (remote/, deployed to trade1 at ~/market-recorder, service name "recorder") plus a status page. The page saves nothing of its own: it reads the streams "heartbeat" and "gaps" and the service settings (products, data_dir, cap_gb, keep_days, min_free_gb; defaults in remote/conf.py DEFAULTS and js/app.js DEFAULTS). remote/README.md lists the recorded files' columns, the live socket's messages, heartbeat.json's fields and the streams; Paper Market Maker, Risk Monitor and Research Notebook depend on those, so keep them stable.
